author: YaIe
body:
You don't get much benefit from the last castle upgrade - I'd say keep the Orns for now. Buy old classes you don't have yet but could benefit from their skills - like druid.  

Once you hit t10 you will need a bunch of Orns, for your desired class but also the new pets that are available. Then you also need more Orns for other t10 classes with good spells - like Beowulf.   

Once you are done with that, you need another chunk of Orns for the Altar of Ascension.  

Unless you REALLY need the Demonforge or the Coliseum - save the Orns for now.

author: dylanthememestealer
body: Pretty sure it will take you a while to get to T10. I would just spend for the upgrade, it gives you access to a gauntlet and coliseum.

author: TwinMugsy
body:
The fortress is a good move for the gauntlet. Then after that you want to save about 3m orns all the time for event pets incase you have one you want pop up in your bestiary. You should have all 20 of your residence and probably 20 shops and 10 bestiaries as a minimum. 


Once you have those basics covered it is a good idea to get all rhe classes up to t7 and especially if you dont have a phoenix pet before t10 get the t9 god class of your faction for deific channel. (All +++)

author: Godzillrah
body: If you can clear 30 tower levels you’ll make that 10 million orn back just off of the achievement. Just some food for thought.

author: Palocos
body: I'd buy most classes before considering final castle upgrade. All you get is a demonforge and a coliseum. Unless you have no demonforges or coliseums near I'd only buy it once you get a large amount of orns (from either endless or towers achievements)

author: LiteCloud
body: Lvl 231, no castle, have demon forge near home, no problems. If you have one near (or not near if you don't mind) you may don't build it at least now, better save some orns for new classes and pets, realmshifter costs 15 mil on its own, most often used pets (Phoenix, ortanite golem and chimera) will cost also more than 10 millions.
